ablation.name: phase4d_lvl2_dwt_rand50
ablation.notes: Phase 4D combo: 2-Level DWT lowpass + DWT freq masking + random_50 mask. Combines multi-level cascade decomposition (lock LL_2) with orthogonal DWT tokenizer and blindfolded mask. Tests if mid-freq release + style purification gives best style-content trade-off.
